$comment: Who may read and write each model of prisma/schema/costing.prisma (rules: src/ownership.ts; roles: src/roles.ts). The office keeps the labour rates and the costing settings through apps/factory-api's modules/costing (B-W1-16), always through command(); the API keeps staff to the companies their grants reach, and the cost grain to send or see a rate. The floor, portal and link sessions read none of it: a cost per minute is a cost (A1 §2.6), and no floor or portal screen needs a rate or an overhead. Nobody deletes a rate (archived) or the settings (changed). After a change run `npm run policies -w @nexus/factory-db -- <folder>`.

LabourRate.about: The office keeps the cost of a standard minute per kind of work centre, tenant-wide or per company, from a day; it archives a rate, never deletes it. The cost sheet reads them.

CostingSettings.about: The office keeps the overhead percentage of each company and the tenant-wide one. The cost sheet reads them.
